title: Ramayana: Part One crosses Rs 150 crore in India in three days, estimates show
dek: Saturday collections rose to about Rs 62 crore net by the evening, according to live tracker estimates; the producers have not released figures.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Ramayana: Part One has crossed Rs 150 crore net at the Indian box office in its first three days, according to estimates from a box office tracking site, as the Diwali weekend brought bigger audiences on Saturday.

The tracker's live estimate at 9:03 pm IST on Saturday put the third-day collection at about Rs 62 crore net, taking the three-day total to about Rs 175 crore net, or Rs 208 crore gross. The Saturday figure was still rising as evening shows were counted, and earlier estimates from the same site during the day were lower, so the final number may change. The film opened with an estimated Rs 64.85 crore net on Thursday and took about Rs 48.05 crore on Friday.

The Hindi version accounts for about three-quarters of the total so far, with the Kannada, Telugu, Tamil and Malayalam versions making up the rest. Occupancy rose to about 40% of seats on Saturday from about 29% on Friday, by the tracker's count. Overseas, the film earned about Rs 95 crore in its first two days.

All these figures are unofficial; the producers have not released their own. Kali Puja and Diwali fall on Sunday, and the holiday is expected to keep collections high through the first weekend.
